items.title: ProFTPD Improper Access Control Vulnerability
items.description: ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

priority.reason: Confirmed exploited (CISA KEV). EPSS 100% probability of exploitation within 30 days. CVSS v3 base score 10.0.

w5h.upgrade_action: Apply current vendor patches for ProFTPD per the advisory (CISA remediation due date: 2026-10-11)
w5h.why_it_matters: This matters because exploitation is confirmed or actively occurring, not theoretical; EPSS puts exploitation probability at 100% within 30 days; critical severity means full compromise is likely if reached.

impact.affected_versions: ProFTPD (specific versions not provided, assume all vulnerable until vendor clarifies)
impact.how_to_check: Inventory all ProFTPD installations and compare versions against the advisory. Review logs on matching hosts for unusual authentication or administrative actions.
